name: Simpli Action Bar
author: simpliplugin

sections.description:
Simpli Action Bar adds configurable call-to-action bars to WordPress pages. Choose from available layouts, customize appearance and messages, display an email form or countdown, and view impression, click, and submission counts.

Features

  • Create and customize Action Bar posts.
  • Choose bar position, colors, text, and display layouts.
  • Display email signup forms with optional automatic email replies.
  • Add a countdown timer.
  • Limit display to desktop or mobile devices.
  • Configure a display delay and cookie-based hiding after signup.
  • Track impressions, clicks, and email submissions locally.
  • View subscribers and export or import supported plugin data.

Privacy and external services

When email signup is enabled, the plugin stores submitted email addresses, submission dates and the visitor’s IP address in this WordPress site’s database. These details can be managed from the Subscribers area. Site administrators should explain this collection in their privacy policy and obtain appropriate consent where applicable.

The plugin can connect to the following third-party services only if the administrator has already supplied the corresponding configuration values. No API credentials are preconfigured. The integrations send subscriber email addresses to the chosen email marketing service after submission. The plugin does not send the site’s locally generated plugin ID to these services.

  • Mailchimp: submitted email and list information are sent to Mailchimp on subscriber signup. Service – Privacy – Terms.
  • Kit (formerly ConvertKit): submitted email and configured form/API information are sent to Kit on subscriber signup. Service – Privacy – Terms.
  • ActiveCampaign: submitted email and configured contact/list information are sent to ActiveCampaign on subscriber signup. Service – Privacy – Terms.
  • Google Analytics: when a Google Analytics measurement ID is saved, Google’s analytics JavaScript is loaded for visitors. Google may collect visitor information under its own policies. Service – Privacy – Terms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simpli-action-bar plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Simpli Action Bar under Plugins.
  3. Create an Action Bar under the Action Bars menu and adjust its display settings.
  4. On a Page, choose a bar and template in the page’s meta box.
  5. Use the plugin’s admin menus to manage subscribers, templates, analytics and export/import settings.
sections.faq:
How do I create a bar?

Create an Action Bar post, then select it from the Action Bar meta box while editing a page.

Does this plugin send subscriber information to external services?

Only if third-party service configuration options have been set up on the site. See the Privacy and external services section for details.
